name: Riyadh Air
verdict: Owned by Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund, which is chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman.

why.text: Riyadh Air belongs to Saudi Arabia’s state fund, which the crown prince chairs. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024, and US intelligence assessed that the crown prince approved the operation that killed journalist Jamal Khashoggi. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
